SELECT DISTINCT
    e.XCL_011 AS event_name,
    ex.XCL_019 AS expense_description
FROM event e
JOIN expense ex ON e.XCL_010 = ex.XCL_021
JOIN budget b ON ex.XCL_023 = b.XCL_003
WHERE e.XCL_013 = 'MU 215'
  AND e.XCL_012 = 'Guest Speaker'
  AND ex.XCL_020 < (
      SELECT AVG(ex2.XCL_020)
      FROM expense ex2
      JOIN budget b2 ON ex2.XCL_023 = b2.XCL_003
      WHERE b2.XCL_004 = 'Advertisement'
  )
